Read the current roster ETag: GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/participants with Authorization: Bearer <access_token>; keep the ETag header (for example "participants-7").
Send PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/participants/assignments
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <access_token>; If-Match: "participants-<revision>"; Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "changes": [ { "participantId": "<SecretaryId>", "role": "Member" } ] }
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict.
Body: { "code": "MSG109", "message": "Cuộc họp phải giữ Chủ toạ và Thư ký theo quy định. Hãy phân công người thay thế." }.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting in Published with its Chair, a Secretary and a Member on the roster.
The Secretary is the only current Secretary.
